229518|decline|v6|claude-haiku-5-5.body:
Thank you for applying with us. After careful review, we are unable to approve your loan application as requested for 545,040.

Several factors in your application raised our estimated risk. About 40% of your past payments were late, and your lowest external credit score was 0.22. The requested term of about 21 payments and a loan amount of 1.21 times the price of the goods also weighed on the decision. Lenders look closely at payment history because it shows how reliably a loan is repaid.

We also noted real strengths. Your highest external credit score was 0.76, and your past loans averaged about 6 payments, which shows you have managed shorter loans before.

A loan on different terms may be possible. A loan officer may be able to offer 545,040 with regular payments of about 23,216 over about 23 payments. This is a possibility the loan officer would need to confirm, not a guarantee.

What generally helps future applications is a record of on-time payments. If you would like us to review this decision, or to discuss a loan on these alternative terms, please contact us and we will be glad to help.

The Lending Team

Thank you for applying with us. We are writing to let you know that your application is under review. This means it is close to the approval threshold, so a loan officer will look at it personally before a final decision is made.

We reviewed several parts of your application. The main factors that lowered our confidence were external credit scores that are on the low side, a requested loan amount that is somewhat higher than the price of the goods it would cover, and a repayment period of about 18 payments. Lenders look at these factors because they help show how well a loan can be repaid.

Your application also has real strengths. Your car is about 4 years old, and none of your payments were late in the last year. On-time payments show a reliable repayment record, which we value.

A loan officer may be able to offer a loan of 508,842 with regular payments of about 27,718 over about 18 payments. We may contact you to talk through adjusting the loan terms. This would be a possibility for the loan officer to confirm, not a guarantee.

If you have questions in the meantime, please reply to this letter.

The Lending Team
